label: 系统设置滚动到其它组
js: (() => { const d=document.querySelector('[data-testid=options-dialog]'); if(!d) return 'missing-dialog'; const all=[d,...d.querySelectorAll('*')]; const scrollables=all.filter(e=>e.scrollHeight>e.clientHeight+4); scrollables.forEach(e=>{e.scrollTop=Math.max(0,e.scrollHeight-e.clientHeight-220)}); return JSON.stringify(scrollables.map(e=>({tag:e.tagName,testid:e.getAttribute('data-testid'),scrollTop:e.scrollTop,scrollHeight:e.scrollHeight,clientHeight:e.clientHeight}))) })()
